Needs changes before merge. Two findings. Safety-tier review: this PR changes tool geometry.

I reviewed the full diff against `upstream/main` at `81365c33bb65e426ee0869eb763a29bd5a91abdb` and its current `AGENTS.md`.
The local trial merge is `9d3d916df1ce1de1dd0ab9856a09b204de94c897`. Its first parent is the PR head.
No earlier review exists. No GitHub runner was used.

The creation, generation, and post checks refuse non-sharp taper tips. The sharp-tip path keeps its prior math.
The body has before/after screenshots. The new structural UI tests pass. No dependency or build-script change needs a maintainer decision.

Requested before merge:

1. **Make the short-flute meridian agree with the profile.** [`crates/tools/src/taper.rs:261`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/597460ab36b68bb8290ee04d75fe528a90dc4fd2/crates/tools/src/taper.rs#L261).
   A 6 mm taper with a 90-degree cone, 1 mm flat tip, zero corner radius, and 1 mm flute length passes `why_not_sane`.
   Its profile reaches radius 3 mm at the flute top. Its meridian ends at radius 1.5 mm there.
   A ball tip with radius 0.5 mm and the same diameter, angle, and flute length also passes validation.
   Its profile reaches radius 3 mm, but its meridian ends at radius 1.2071067811865475 mm.
   When `top == fl`, the final branch omits the radial shoulder that `Tool::profile` adds.
   Make both representations agree, or refuse these dimensions at tool creation. Add short-flute tests for both forms.
   I reproduced both failures with tests outside the worktree. The current operation checks block these tools from G-code.

2. **Declare the project format change as breaking.** [`crates/app/src/project/file.rs:190`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/597460ab36b68bb8290ee04d75fe528a90dc4fd2/crates/app/src/project/file.rs#L190).
   This PR writes project version 79 for non-sharp tips. Older builds refuse those files.
   The title and commits have no `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.
   The current `AGENTS.md`, “Commits and Releases”, requires that declaration for an incompatible project-file change.
   Add the required breaking-change declaration. Keep the safety version guard.

Fix for the review of head `597460ab3`. The new head is `ee24e1c73`.

1. **The short-flute meridian now agrees with the profile.** Commit `ee24e1c73` closes this finding.
   - `meridian_points` in `crates/tools/src/taper.rs` now adds the radial shoulder at the flute top when the flute ends on the cone. `Tool::profile` draws the same shoulder.
   - I did not refuse these dimensions. A short flute on a tapered mill is a real tool, and the profile already drew it correctly.
   - New tests: `taper::tests::short_flat_profile_and_meridian_agree` and `taper::tests::short_ball_profile_and_meridian_agree`. I wrote them first. Before the fix they failed with your numbers: the meridian ended at `(1.0, 1.5)` and at `(1.0, 1.2071067811865475)`, and the profile at r 3. After the fix they pass.
   - `meridian::tests::a_flat_and_a_ball_taper_meridian_agrees_with_the_profile` has the two short-flute tools too. That test also builds their solid atoms.
   - A sharp taper does not change. `meridian::tests::a_sharp_taper_keeps_its_profile_and_digest` passes.
   - The drawn profile (`taper::outline`) already had the shoulder. No other code builds the tip geometry.
   - Note: the sharp taper and the drill meridian on `main` also end without this shoulder when the flute is shorter than the cone. This PR does not change it, because a sharp taper must stay bit for bit. It is a separate item.

2. **The format change is declared as breaking.** Commit `ee24e1c73` closes this finding.
   - The PR title is now `feat(tools)!: a tapered mill has a tip form (sharp, flat, ball)`.
   - The commit has a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. A project with a flat or ball taper tip is written as version 79, and older CamCraft builds refuse it. A project with only sharp tips stays version 78.
   - The PR body has a "Breaking change" section. The `Changelog:` line starts with "Breaking".
   - The version guard does not change.

- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main`: no conflict.

2. **Breaking format declaration: fixed in `ee24e1c73`.** The commit has a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. The title has `!`. The body and `Changelog:` line state the incompatible versions. The version guard remains.
